games.name: Upistry
games.pitch: One-tap stacking game: land each block perfectly, misses slice the tower thinner. 30 hand-drawn worlds from the seaside to outer space, daily challenge, plays in the browser on phone and desktop.

games.name: Puff's Burrow
games.pitch: A cozy little pet that lives in a rotatable 3D diorama on real time: four homes (autumn forest, snowy lake, jungle, island), four residents, daily wishes, tricks, fishing, hide-and-seek, garden, Advent surprises in December. Plays in the browser on phone and desktop.
games.events: new/<place>/<character>/<lang> = new creature; open/<lang>/d<age bucket> = returning player by creature age in days; err/... = JavaScript errors
games.note: Not yet on itch.io; GitHub Pages version only until itch_id is filled in.
